text: ぼくが　なに　やってるか　わかる？

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the casual form of ている, for something going on now. やってる = 'is doing'.

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.explanation: か inside a sentence turns a question into part of it. なにやってるかわかる = 'do you know what I'm doing?'.
